content.text:
Git does not store a worktree creation timestamp. You can inspect filesystem timestamps:

```bash
git worktree list --porcelain |
awk '/^worktree / {print substr($0, 11)}' |
while IFS= read -r wt; do
  printf '\n%s\n' "$wt"
  stat -c 'created: %w\nmodified: %y' "$wt"
done
```

On Linux, `%w` is the filesystem birth time; it may show `-` if unsupported.

To see the age of the worktree’s current commit instead:

```bash
git -C /path/to/worktree log -1 --format='commit: %ci (%cr)'
```

You can also inspect branch checkout history, if reflogs are available:

```bash
git reflog show --date=iso branch-name
```

These are approximate—Git itself has no authoritative worktree age field.

arguments.command:
git worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | while IFS= read -r wt; do
  if [[ ! -e "$wt" ]]; then
    printf '%s\tMISSING\n' "$wt"
    continue
  fi
  created=$(stat -c '%w' -- "$wt")
  if [[ "$created" == "-" ]]; then
    created=$(stat -c '%y' -- "$wt")
  fi
  created_epoch=$(date -d "$created" +%s 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [[ -n "$created_epoch" ]]; then
    seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - created_epoch ))
    days=$(( seconds / 86400 ))
    hours=$(( (seconds % 86400) / 3600 ))
    age="${days}d ${hours}h"
  else
    age="unknown"
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$wt" "$created" "$age"
done

# ~/.bashrc: executed by bash(1) for non-login shells.

# Note: PS1 and umask are already set in /etc/profile. You should not
# need this unless you want different defaults for root.
# PS1='${debian_chroot:+($debian_chroot)}\h:\w\$ '
# umask 022

# You may uncomment the following lines if you want `ls' to be colorized:
# export LS_OPTIONS='--color=auto'
# eval "$(dircolors)"
# alias ls='ls $LS_OPTIONS'
# alias ll='ls $LS_OPTIONS -l'
# alias l='ls $LS_OPTIONS -lA'
#
# Some more alias to avoid making mistakes:
# alias rm='rm -i'
# alias cp='cp -i'
# alias mv='mv -i'
export HOME=/root
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"

export PATH=/opt/mw-agent/bin:/root/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

# amp
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
eval "$(/root/.local/bin/mise activate bash)"

# Herdr replaces Zellij for persistent terminal sessions.
# Start it manually with: herdr

# opencode
export PATH=/root/.opencode/bin:$PATH


# Added by Antigravity CLI installer
export PATH="/root/.local/bin:$PATH"

# fnm
FNM_PATH="/root/.local/share/fnm"
if [ -d "$FNM_PATH" ]; then
  export PATH="$FNM_PATH:$PATH"
  eval "$(fnm env --shell bash)"
fi

# bun
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
